title: DHIS2 Working List
description: A composable React 18 Working List block for DHIS2 tracker programs.
docs: Render WorkingList beneath the DHIS2 app-runtime and TanStack Query providers. Compose WorkingListViewSwitcher, WorkingListToolbar with its column/filter/action controls, and WorkingListTable. View selection and pagination work uncontrolled by default or as independent controlled value/callback pairs.
